original: paśyāmīti| aninditāṃ sarvāṅgasundarīmityarthaḥ, tāṃ tava kāntāmityarthaḥ, anaṅgajena kāmakṛtena, ātaṅkena rogeṇa, kāmapīḍayā ityarthaḥ, laṅghitām ākrāntām, ata eva kaṭhoreṇa nirdayena, kālena mṛtyunā, grastāmeva kavilitāmena, paśyāmi, tvadāśayā tava pratyāśayā, naḥ asmākaṃ, kim? kiṃ phalam? tvāmanāsādayantī idānīṃ kāmapīḍayā sā mriyate, ataḥ tava
analyzed: paśyāmi iti aninditām sarva aṅga sundarīm iti arthaḥ tām tava kāntām iti arthaḥ anaṅga jena kāma kṛtena ātaṅkena rogeṇa kāma pīḍayā iti arthaḥ laṅghitām ākrāntām atas eva kaṭhoreṇa nirdayena kālena mṛtyunā grastām eva paśyāmi tvad āśayā tava pratyāśayā naḥ asmākam kim kim phalam tvām anāsādayantī idānīm kāma pīḍayā sā mriyate atas tava

original: pratyāśayā prayojanaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ| athavā, aṅgajena ātaṅkena śārīrikapīḍayā, na laṅghīteti anaṅgajātaṅkalāṅghitā tāṃ, kaṭhore tīvreṇa, kālena grīṣmeṇetyarthaḥ, grāstāṃ paśyāmi, tvadāśayā naḥ kim? tasyāḥ śarīrikī pīḍaā kā'pi nāstī, kevalaṃ tvadaprāptinimittacintīdibhirapagatanidrā grīṣmakālajanitasantāpena sā nitarāṃ pīḍayate iti pūrvoktārtha
analyzed: pratyāśayā prayojanam na asti iti arthaḥ athavā aṅga jena ātaṅkena śārīrika pīḍayā na laṅghīta iti anaṅga ja ātaṅka lāṅghitā tām kaṭhore tīvreṇa kālena grīṣmeṇa iti arthaḥ paśyāmi tvad āśayā naḥ kim tasyāḥ śarīrikī pīḍaā kā api kevalam tvad aprāpti nimitta cintī ādibhiḥ apagata nidrā grīṣma kāla janita santāpena sā nitarām pīḍayate iti pūrva ukta arthaḥ

original: evāsya ślokasya pratipādyaḥ kiṃ parārthaḥ ityeṣa saṃśayaḥ| (sa ca dūtyāvivakṣitā eva| proṣitaṃ nāyakaṃ prati dūtyā uktiriyam) | | 142| |

original: atra ca asya guṇatvamupapādayati, kāmātrteti| dūtī yuvānam ākulīkatrtuṃ nāyikāsamīpagamanāya utsukaṃ katrtuṃ, narmaṇā bhaṅgyā, kāmātrtā gharmataptā grīṣmātrtā vā, iti aniściyakaraṃ sandehasaṅkulam, iti pūrvoktarūpaṃ, vacaḥ āha, kāmapīḍitā grīṣmapīḍitā vā iti nirṇetumaśakyatayā yuvā'yam ākulībhūya tatsamīpaṃ yāsyatīti manasikṛtya dūtī tādṛśaṃ
analyzed: atra ca asya guṇa tvam upapādayati kāma ātrtā iti dūtī yuvānam ākulīkatrtum nāyikā samīpa gamanāya utsukam katrtum narmaṇā bhaṅgyā kāma ātrtā gharma taptā grīṣma ātrtā vā iti aniściya karam sandeha saṅkulam iti pūrva ukta rūpam vacaḥ āha kāma pīḍitā grīṣma pīḍitā vā iti nirṇetum aśakya tayā ākulībhūya tad samīpam yāsyati iti manasi kṛtya dūtī tādṛśam anubhūya anubhūya tat samīpam yāsyati iti manasi kṛtya dūtī tādṛśam anubhūya

analyzed: sandigdham vacanam provāca iti asya guṇa tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: apakramaṃ nirūpayati, uddeśeti| arthānāṃ vaktavyaviṣayāṇām, uddeśāniguṇaḥ uddeśaḥ ādāvipanyāsaḥ ityarthaḥ, tasya anuguṇaḥ anukūlaṛ, anvayayogya ityarthaḥ, anu paścāt, uddeśaḥ upanyāsaḥ, kramānusāreṇa vinyāsa ityarthaḥ cet yadi, na kṛtaḥ, tadā budhāḥ tam apakramaḥ abhidhānaṃ nāma yasya tathoktaṃ, kramalaṅghanāt apakramākhyaṃ, doṣam ācakṣate
analyzed: apakramam nirūpayati uddeśa iti arthānām vaktavya viṣayāṇām uddeśaḥ ādau ipanyāsaḥ iti arthaḥ tasya anuguṇaḥ anvaya yogyaḥ iti arthaḥ anu paścāt uddeśaḥ upanyāsaḥ krama anusāreṇa vinyāsaḥ iti arthaḥ ced yadi na kṛtaḥ tadā budhāḥ tam apakramaḥ abhidhānam nāma yasya tathā uktam krama laṅghanāt apakrama ākhyam doṣam ācakṣate

original: kathayanti| (tathā ca, kāyryākāraṇabhūtānāmarthānāṃ yathākramamupanyāsa eva gumaḥ, tallaṅghanantu doṣa eveti bhāvaḥ| ayañca doṣaḥ śabdārthadoṣayorakramatvaduṣkramatvayoranyairuktayorantarbhavati, kintu tayornātyantaparihāryyatvam; yaduktaṃ viśvanāthena, "dvayaṃ gataṃ samprati śocanīyatāṃ, samāgamaprārthanayā pinākinaḥ|
analyzed: kathayanti tathā ca kāyryā kāraṇa bhūtānām arthānām yathākramam upanyāsaḥ eva doṣaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ ayaḥ ca doṣaḥ śabda artha doṣayoḥ akrama tva duṣkrama tvayoḥ anyaiḥ uktayoḥ antarbhavati kintu tayoḥ na atyanta parihāryya tvam yat uktam viśvanāthena dvayam gatam samprati śocanīya tām samāgama prārthanayā pinākinaḥ

original: kalā ca sā kāntimatī kalāvatastvamasya lokasya ca netrakomudī| | atra tvamityanantarameva cakaro yuktaḥ"iti| tathā"dehi me vājinaṃ rājan! gajendraṃ vā madālasam| atra gajendrasya prathamayācanamucitam" iti|
analyzed: kalā ca sā kāntimatī kalāvataḥ tvam asya lokasya ca netra komudī atra tvam iti anantaram eva cakaraḥ yuktaḥ iti tathā dehi me vājinam rājan gaja indram vā mada alasam atra gaja indrasya prathama yācanam ucitam iti

original: dvayamityādau parāmṛṣyamāṇavākyānantaraṃ prayoktavyasya cakārasyānyatra prayuktatayā kramo laṅghito'pi vyavahitasyāpi yojanayā anvayanirbādhāt nātidoṣaṃ bhajate|
analyzed: dvayam ityādau parāmṛṣyamāṇa vākya anantaram prayoktavyasya cakārasya anyatra prayukta tayā kramaḥ laṅghitaḥ api vyavahitasya api yojanayā anvaya nirbādhāt na ati doṣam bhajate

original: deh me ityādau ca pradhānasya prathamaprārthanamucitaṃ, taddāne dāturasāmathrye tato nyūnaṃ yācanīyamiti kramaḥ, iha tu tallṅghanāt apakramatvaṃ, kintu anvayanirbādhatvena nātyantaparihāyryatvam ityubhayatrāpi anvayasya bādhābāvānnātyantaparihāyryateti vibhāvyam|
analyzed: deh me ityādau ca pradhānasya prathama prārthanam ucitam tad dāne dātuḥ asāmathrye tatas nyūnam yācanīyam iti kramaḥ iha tu tad lṅghanāt apakrama tvam kintu anvaya nirbādha tvena na atyanta parihāyrya tvam iti ubhayatra api anvayasya bādhā bāvāt na atyanta parihāyrya tā iti vibhāvyam

original: asya tu kramikāṇāṃ kramikairevānvaya iti niyamalaṅghanādanvayabodhabādhakatvenātyantaparihāyryatvamiti viśeṣaḥ) | | 144| |
analyzed: asya tu kramikāṇām kramikaiḥ eva anvayaḥ iti niyama laṅghanāt anvaya bodha bādhaka tvena atyanta parihāyrya tvam iti viśeṣaḥ 144

original: apakramaṃ darśayati, sthitīti| jagatāṃ sthitiḥ pālanaṃ, nirmāṇaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhāraḥ dhvaṃsa, teṣāṃ hetavaḥ kāraṇāni, katrtāraḥ ityarthaḥ, amī ete sambhūnārāyaṇāmbhojayonayaḥ śivaviṣṇu bramhāṇaḥ, vaḥ yuṣmān, pālayantu rakṣantu|
analyzed: apakramam darśayati sthiti iti jagatām sthitiḥ pālanam nirmāṇam sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhāraḥ dhvaṃsa teṣām hetavaḥ kāraṇāni katrtāraḥ iti arthaḥ amī ete sambhū nārāyaṇa ambhoja yonayaḥ śiva viṣṇu bramhāṇaḥ vaḥ yuṣmān pālayantu rakṣantu

original: (atra prathamoddiṣṭānāṃ sthitinirmāṇasaṃhārāṇāṃyathākramamanvaye katrtavye nārāyaṇāmbojayoniśambhava iti vaktumucitaṃ, parantu tadviparītamuktamiti śābdabodhavighaṭakatvāt apakramatā) | | 145| |
analyzed: atra prathama uddiṣṭānām sthiti nirmāṇa saṃhārāṇām yathākramam anvaye katrtavye nārāyaṇa amboja yoni śambhavaḥ iti vaktum ucitam parantu tad viparītam uktam iti śābdabodha vighaṭaka tvāt apakrama tā

original: asyādoṣatvamapi kvacidityāha, yatna iti| sambandhasya anvayasya, vijñānaṃ viśeṣeṇāvabodha eva, heturyasya tādṛśaḥ, yatnaḥ viśiṣṭasambandhabodhāyaiva tādṛśakramalaṅghanaprayāsa ityarthaḥ, yadyapi kṛtaḥ, kavineti śeṣaḥ, tadā sūrayaḥ vidvāmalasaḥ, kramalaṅghanamapi dūṣaṇaṃ doṣāvahaṃ, naiva āhuḥ| | 146| |
analyzed: asya adoṣa tvam api kvacid iti āha yatnaḥ iti sambandhasya anvayasya vijñānam viśeṣeṇa avabodhaḥ eva hetuḥ yasya tādṛśaḥ yatnaḥ viśiṣṭa sambandha bodhāya eva tādṛśa krama laṅghana prayāsaḥ iti arthaḥ yadi api kṛtaḥ kavinā iti śeṣaḥ tadā sūrayaḥ vidvām alasaḥ krama laṅghanam api dūṣaṇam doṣa āvaham na eva āhuḥ

original: apakramasyādoṣatva mudāharatisa bandhityāga iti| bandhutyāgaḥ svajanaparihāraḥ, tanutyāgaḥ dehābhāvaḥ, deśatyāgaḥ videṣāvasthitiḥ, iti triṣu viṣayeṣu madhye ādyantau bandhutyāgadeśatyāgau, āyatāḥ dīrghāḥ, kleśāḥ yayoḥ tau, madhyamastanutyāgastu, kṣaṇikajvaraḥ kṣaṇamātrasantāpakara ityarthaḥ, varaṃ tanutyāgaḥ śreyān na ca punaḥ bandhutyāgaḥ
analyzed: apakramasya adoṣa tvam udāharati sa bandhi tyāgaḥ iti bandhu tyāgaḥ sva jana parihāraḥ tanutyāgaḥ deha abhāvaḥ deśa tyāgaḥ videṣa avasthitiḥ iti triṣu viṣayeṣu madhye ādi antau bandhu tyāga deśa tyāgau āyatāḥ dīrghāḥ kleśāḥ yayoḥ tau madhyamaḥ tanutyāgaḥ tu kṣaṇika jvaraḥ kṣaṇa mātra santāpa karaḥ iti arthaḥ varam tanutyāgaḥ śreyān na ca punar bandhu tyāgaḥ

original: deśatyāgo vā iti bhāvaḥ| (atra yathākramamuddiṣṭeṣu bandhutyāgādiṣu āyatakleśāvityena oādipadagṛhitasya bandhutyāgasyānvayitve tadittaroddiṣṭasya tanu tyāgāsyānvayāyogāt tamullaṅghya tadantasya deśatyāgastānvayitvamiti kramalaṅghanaṃ sambandhavijñānahetutvāt yujyate eva iti na doṣāya, pratyuta tanutyāgāt bandhutyāgadeśatyāgayoḥ garīyastvena
analyzed: deśa tyāgaḥ vā iti bhāvaḥ atra yathākramam uddiṣṭeṣu bandhu tyāga ādiṣu o ādi pada gṛhitasya bandhu tyāgasya anvayi tve tad ittara uddiṣṭasya tanu tyāga āsya anvaya ayogāt tam ullaṅghya tad antasya deśa tyāgaḥ tad anvayi tvam iti krama laṅghanam sambandha vijñāna hetu tvāt yujyate eva iti na doṣāya pratyuta tanu tyāgāt bandhu tyāga deśa tyāgayoḥ garīyas tvena

original: śabjahīnaṃ nirūpayati, śabdahīnamiti| anālakṣyā adṛśyā, aparijñeyā iti yāvat, tasyā aśāstrīyatvāditi bhāvaḥ, lakṣyasya sajātīyodāharaṇāntarasya, tathā lakṣaṇasya anuśāsanasya, sūtrakoṣadhātupāṭhādirūpaniyāmakasyetyarthaḥ, paddhatiḥ niyamaḥ yatra tādṛśaḥ agaṇitānuśāsana ityarthaḥ, tathā aśiṣṭānām ajñānām, iṣṭaḥ anavabodhavijṛmbhita ityarthaḥ,
analyzed: śabjahīnam nirūpayati śabdahīnam iti anālakṣyā adṛśyā aparijñeyā iti yāvat tasyāḥ aśāstrīya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ lakṣyasya sajātīya udāharaṇa antarasya tathā lakṣaṇasya anuśāsanasya sūtra koṣa dhātu pāṭha ādi rūpa niyāmakasya iti arthaḥ paddhatiḥ niyamaḥ yatra tādṛśaḥ agaṇita anuśāsanaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā aśiṣṭānām ajñānām iṣṭaḥ anavabodha vijṛmbhitaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: padānāṃ padayoḥ padasya vā prayogaḥ vyavahāraḥ, kṛdabhihitabhāvatvāt prayujyamānaṃ padamityarthaḥ, śabdahīnaṃ śabdena anuśāsanaśāstreṇa hīnaṃ, tadākhyadoṣavān ityarthaḥ, sudhībhiraprayuktatayā niṣpādakānuśāsanābhāvācca yasya sajātīyodāharaṇāntaraṃ nāsti tādṛśapadaprayogaḥ śiṣṭāvyavahṛtapadaprayogaśca śabdahīnākhyadoṣavāniti niṣkarṣaḥ|
analyzed: padānām padayoḥ padasya vā prayogaḥ vyavahāraḥ kṛt abhihita bhāva tvāt prayujyamānam padam iti arthaḥ śabdahīnam śabdena anuśāsana śāstreṇa hīnam tad ākhya doṣavān iti arthaḥ sudhībhiḥ aprayukta tayā niṣpādaka anuśāsana abhāvāt ca yasya sajātīya udāharaṇa antaram na asti tādṛśa pada prayogaḥ śiṣṭa avyavahṛta pada prayogaḥ ca śabdahīna ākhya doṣavān iti niṣkarṣaḥ

original: (tataśca yādṛśapadasyānuśāsanaṃ sajātīyaprayogāntarañca na vidyete tādṛśaṃ padaṃ tathā satyapyanuśāsane tattalliṅgādimattvena tattadarthakatvena vā śiṣṭairaprayuktaoñca padaṃ śabdahīnākhyadoṣavaditi lakṣaṇam) | kiñca śiṣṭānāmuktau anuśāsanaviruddhatvamapi na doṣāyetyāha, śiṣṭeti|
analyzed: tatas ca yādṛśa padasya anuśāsanam sajātīya prayoga antaram ca na vidyete tādṛśam padam tathā sati api anuśāsane tat tat liṅga ādimattvena tat tad arthaka tvena vā śiṣṭaiḥ padam śabdahīna ākhya doṣavat iti lakṣaṇam kiñca śiṣṭānām uktau anuśāsana viruddha tvam api na doṣāya iti āha śiṣṭa iti

original: śiṣṭeṣṭastu śiṣṭaiḥ sādhubhirbahubhiḥ iṣṭaḥ abhimatatayā vyavahṛtastu, na duṣyati na doṣāya bhavati| jhrpadānāṃ nityatvāt tadvyatpattyarthamevānusāsanaṃ pāṇinyādibhiḥ kṛtamitiśiṣṭānāmuktau sūtrāṇāmabhāve anuśāsanakāriṇa eva daṇḍanīyāḥ, na tatra doṣa itibhāvaḥ|
analyzed: śiṣṭa iṣṭaḥ tu śiṣṭaiḥ sādhubhiḥ bahubhiḥ iṣṭaḥ abhimata tayā vyavahṛtaḥ tu na duṣyati na doṣāya bhavati nitya tvāt tad vyatpatti artham eva anusāsanam pāṇini ādibhiḥ kṛtam iti śiṣṭānām uktau sūtrāṇām abhāve anuśāsana kāriṇaḥ eva daṇḍanīyāḥ na tatra doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: goyīcandreṇāpi "nityānāṃ padānāṃ pratipattyarthaṃ prakṛtipratyayavibhāgaparikalpanaṃ śāstreṇa kriyate" ityuktatayā anuśāsanasya śiṣṭavyavahṛtapadāt paratvameva pratipāditam| tataścānuśāsanābāve'pi bahubhiḥ prayuktapadaprayogo nāsya doṣasya viṣayaḥ, tathā satyapyanuśāsane tādṛśaḥ padaprayogo yadi kairapi na kṛtaḥ tatprayogastu doṣa eveti bodhyam|
analyzed: goyīcandreṇa api nityānām padānām pratipatti artham prakṛti pratyaya vibhāga parikalpanam śāstreṇa kriyate iti ukta tayā anuśāsanasya śiṣṭa vyavahṛta padāt paratvam eva pratipāditam tatas ca anuśāsana abāve pi bahubhiḥ prayukta pada prayogaḥ na asya doṣasya viṣayaḥ tathā sati api anuśāsane tādṛśaḥ pada prayogaḥ yadi kaiḥ api na kṛtaḥ tad prayogaḥ tu doṣaḥ eva iti bodhyam

original: śabdaśāstraviruddhapadaprayoge tu anyairasādhutvamityuktaṃ, tathā ca vāmanaḥ, "śabdasmṛtiviruddhamasādhu" iti| aprayuktāsamarthadoṣayorapyanyairuktayoranenaiva saṅgrahaḥ kṛtaḥ iti dikṭa| | 148| |
analyzed: śabda śāstra viruddha pada prayoge tu anyaiḥ asādhu tvam iti uktam tathā ca vāmanaḥ śabda smṛti viruddham asādhu iti aprayukta asamartha doṣayoḥ api anyaiḥ uktayoḥ anena eva saṅgrahaḥ kṛtaḥ iti

original: śabdahīnamudāharati, avate iti| he mahārājan! bhavate bhavataḥ bāhuḥ bhujaḥ, arṇavaḥ sāgaraḥ, śakkarī mekhalā yasyāḥ tāṃ sasāgaramityarthaḥ, ("śakkarī chandaso bhede nadīmekhalayorapi"iti medinī) mahīm avate pālayati, ajijñāsā saṃśayābhāvāt atra jijñāsā na vidyate, satyamevaitadityarta, ityasāṃ prāguktānāmīdṛśīnāṃ girāṃ vācāṃ, rasaḥ
analyzed: śabda hīnam udāharati avate iti he mahā rājan bhavate bhavataḥ bāhuḥ bhujaḥ arṇavaḥ sāgaraḥ śakkarī mekhalā yasyāḥ tām sa sāgaram iti arthaḥ śakkarī chandasaḥ bhede nadī mekhalayoḥ api iti medinī mahīm avate pālayati ajijñāsā saṃśaya abhāvāt atra jijñāsā na vidyate satyam eva etat iti artaḥ iti asām prāguktānām īdṛśīnām girām vācām rasaḥ

original: mādhuyryānuguṇaḥ āsvādaḥ, nāsti, proktapadānāmasādhutvāt anvayabodhaprātikūlyena śrṛṅgārarasānuprāṇitarājaviṣayakaratibhāvasyānudramāditi bhāvaḥ|
